Proposed diagram changes
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: MappingPage                              baseline 03f2168, before tldraw
  |   |   `-- Replace DiagramService content-writer relationships with explicit revision operations and retention; preserve the workspace, controller and history organization.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: MappingPage                              baseline 03f2168, before tldraw
  |   |   `-- Show document.diagramContexts associations keyed by diagramId, referencing DiagramAgentContext; distinguish these from Diagram.sourceContext evidence and canvas editing contexts.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [D] Controller edits / agent access
  |   |   `-- Replace DiagramService.create/revise calls with revision commands and installation of issued revisions. Keep controller batches distinct from separately committed exec mutations.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
  |   |   `-- Correct append's revision-issuance responsibility: history binds and retains issued immutable revisions rather than independently creating changed content. Preserve checkpoint navigation and retention detail.
  |   `-- [4] Redraw: [G] DiagramService
  |       `-- Replace the obsolete single-service boundary with createDiagram/reviseDiagram/deriveDiagram, diagramRevisionStore retention, generateDiagram orchestration and controller publication. Connect the existing content-edit and history callers to these explicit components.
  |
  |-- AgentContext - implemented call flow and domain models (03f2168)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: (O) Edit diagram with AgentContext - baseline 03f2168
  |   |   |-- Reorganize around context acquisition, pinned request capture, candidate generation/submission, revision retention and canvas acknowledgement; the original single upload-to-replacement flow is insufficient.
  |   |   |-- Show AgentContextService resolving scoped uploads or AgentContextLibrary records; show panel-supplied context and fingerprint-matched document.diagramContexts fallback separately.
  |   |   |-- Place AgentContextLibrary with its repository and AgentContextSources dependencies, and DiagramAgentContextStore behind loadDiagramAgentContext, before linking their details.
  |   |   `-- Preserve version guards and retry behavior; distinguish in-place installation, retained variants with optional presentation promotion, and new-diagram placement. Updated conversation context becomes visible only after acknowledgement.
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: [D1] EditDiagramInput - request domain
  |   |   |-- Reorganize the request around target/preconditions, context identity, edit scope and generation configuration; uploaded history is no longer its only context source.
  |   |   `-- Show required edit-mode and replace-mode, whole/single/multiple subtree targets, pinned references, template selection, llmSessionId and mutually exclusive context inputs. Keep create/extend-only fields separate.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [D2] Diagram edit run - asynchronous execution
  |   |   |-- Add operation, saved-context ID/hash, runtime agentSessionId, pending next context and retained variant/creation outputs; the request-owned asynchronous lifecycle still fits.
  |   |   `-- Attach these fields to Captured input and Retained output; retries reuse retained results rather than regenerating them.
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: [D3] AgentContext - implemented domain object and adapter
  |   |   |-- Separate immutable compact descriptors, optional portable sourceFiles attachments and resolved model history; this replaces the conversation-text-only representation.
  |   |   |-- Preserve branch slicing, tool-group validation and copied-message semantics. Add sourceRange constituents, v1/v2 validation, fromMessages and resolveSources before toPiMessages.
  |   |   `-- Explain that sourceFiles are excluded from the descriptor hash, while resolving references produces a separate text snapshot and hash. Domain validation remains separate from source I/O.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [D4] Diagram-edit agent session - runtime model
  |   |   `-- Replace in-memory session ownership with persisted SessionManager sessions gated by AI enablement. Persisted runtime transcripts are not explicitly saved AgentContext library records.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [D4] Diagram-edit agent session - runtime model
  |   |   `-- Add source resolution before history conversion, panel-owned llmSessionId versus runtime agentSessionId, and returned conversation capture. Preserve configuration isolation and non-reexecution of historical tool calls.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [D5] Revision and canvas bindings - output domain
  |   |   `-- Add retained candidate/review outputs and optional presentation alternatives alongside bound revisions. Retention, presentation selection and content publication remain separate operations; link existing review detail rather than duplicating it.
  |   |-- [2] Add: AgentContextLibrary - explicit save and reuse
  |   |   |-- Develop the canvas's AgentContext subject with explicit creation from text, snapshots or text/sourceFile constituents; no automatic capture of the current chat.
  |   |   |-- Show immutable saved-agent-context IDs, UUID retry/conflict checks, atomic repository publication, summary listing and compact versus resolved reads. IDs survive restarts within the application store.
  |   |   `-- Attach from the redrawn overview's AgentContextLibrary node to FileAgentContextRepository and AgentContextSources; contrast scoped, backend-lifetime uploads without duplicating their implementation.
  |   |-- [2] Add: AgentContextSources - pinning and lazy resolution
  |   |   |-- Explain how source evidence remains reproducible: registered sourceId plus relative path and inclusive range, pinned to a Git commit or content-addressed snapshot.
  |   |   |-- Show capture/persist/read/portable boundaries, unchanged Git reuse, shared source blobs, range validation and selected-evidence portable exports. Resolution does not mutate the saved descriptor.
  |   |   `-- Attach from AgentContextLibrary's AgentContextSources dependency and DiagramAgentContextStore's source dependency; both use FileAgentContextSources.
  |   `-- [2] Add: DiagramAgentContext - association and reuse
  |       |-- Explain compiled source evidence, diagramId, compiledFromRevisionId, sourceFingerprint and inline versus backing-record storage; the current diagram still comes from each edit request.
  |       |-- Show load validation and fingerprint-gated fallback only when generation has neither supplied context nor a supplied edit candidate. Do not treat the association as a saved library record.
  |       `-- Attach from the overview's document.diagramContexts and loadDiagramAgentContext nodes; connect storage to FileDiagramAgentContextStore.
  |
  |-- Mapping page - MCP and HTTP API  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
  |   |   `-- Remove the fixed twelve-tool claim and update edit-diagram's contract for explicit edit/replace modes and saved or uploaded context IDs; preserve unrelated interface descriptions.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
  |   |   `-- Add create-agent-context, list-agent-contexts and read-agent-context as explicit library operations, distinct from agent-context.upload and generation. Attach them to the backend AgentContextLibrary component.
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
  |       |-- Expand Agent context into AgentContextService upload/resolve, AgentContextLibrary and shared AgentContextSources; add DiagramAgentContextStore to prompt-driven editing.
  |       `-- Preserve the responsibility grouping; link these explicit component nodes to the AgentContext canvas's lifecycle details rather than repeating them here.
  |
  `-- PersistentLayer  existing canvas
      `-- [1b] Extend: PersistentLayer
          |-- Add FileAgentContextRepository at agent-contexts, FileDiagramAgentContextStore at diagram-agent-contexts, and shared source blobs at agent-context-sources; backend composition wires them using storeRoot.
          |-- Distinguish saved library identity, diagram association backing records and source hashes. Canvas state can retain compact context references; source text is resolved separately.
          `-- This extends the existing storage overview without changing its catalog/workspace publication boundaries. Connect the named stores to their AgentContext lifecycle diagrams; do not imply DiagramStore owns the new services.
